mechanism: Timolol ophthalmic may enhance the hypoglycemic effect of glyburide and mask hypoglycemia symptoms through beta-blockade, while systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol can potentiate glucose-lowering effects.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely when initiating or adjusting timolol ophthalmic; counsel patient on hypoglycemia recognition since beta-blockade may mask tachycardia and tremor; consider alternative ophthalmic agent if glycemic control becomes problematic.
